strings.en: There!
I won't let you do any more!
Hit!
Got you!
Go down!
How about this!
I'll be your opponent!
Just go down already!
Why you!
Underestimate me because I'm a girl, and you'll get hurt!
Coming my way, huh... You're mine!!
Geez! Go down already!
Here they come! Time to give it my all!!
Don't think I, Roux Louka, am just some ordinary girl!
I'm a Newtype too, you know!
I think I can handle it better than Judau!
Glemy! If you show up in front of me again!
Give it a rest, Glemy!!
Roux Louka, Zeta Gundam! Here I go!!
I can use the Zeta Gundam too!
I'll take care of that enemy with the Zeta Gundam!
Leave this to me and the Zeta Gundam!
I'll master the Double Zeta too!
I'll take you on with the Double Zeta!
I'll show you the Double Zeta's power!
I can't leave everything to Judau!
Attacking with the Mk-II!
Let's go, Mk-II!
This is how you use the Gundam Mk-II!
I'll take you on with the Gundam Mk-II!
I'm not really used to piloting this kind of mobile suit...
A Zeon-type mobile suit's nice once in a while.
I can pilot anything... Wait, isn't this one kinda old!?
I'll break through here with the Gundam!
I'm counting on you, Gundam!
With this Gundam, I can do it!
With this Gundam, I won't let the enemy have their way!
No way!? I got hit!?
Agh! No, I've lost control!!
No, it won't hold!?
Kyaaah! Wh-what power!?
Kyaah! You're kidding, this is seriously bad!
Ngh! Huh!? Damage to the power unit!? This is bad...
Wh-what is this!? Nobody told me about this!!
D-don't think I'll back down over something like this!!
N-not yet! This is where I get to shine!!
Kyaah! P-pulling through from here is what I do best!
Ah! I can't believe the Double Zeta's taken this much!
I-if I take another hit, even the Zeta...!
Please, Gundam! Hang in there a little longer!!
Owww... You'll pay for that!
Ow! Not yet! I won't be beaten by this much!
Agh! Why you, now I'm mad!!
Agh! You're better than I thought!
Ngh! Why you, not bad!
Hey! What's the big idea, treating a girl like this!?
Huh? Is this starting to turn bad...?
Ngh! Now's my chance to show what I can do!
I was ready for this much damage from the start!
This is nothing, the Double Zeta can still take it!
Eek! Did you aim for the Zeta's thin armor!?
A Gundam can shrug off this much damage!
Oh no, I got hit!
Oh, did something hit me?
As if I'd go down from this much!
Oh my, you're weaker than I thought.
You think I'll let out a cute little scream over this!?
Kyaaah!! ...Wait, that wasn't so bad after all.
Oh, maybe... you're going easy on me?
Hmph... What a boring attack.
Hmm, you plan to shoot down the Double Zeta with that?
That's the Zeta Gundam for you! Not a scratch.
No need to hold back against a Gundam!
Oh my, you're weaker than I thought.
Amateur!
Eek! That was dangerous!
As if it'd hit me!
I dodged it! Amazing, that's me for you!!
I'll dodge it!
From the left? No, straight ahead!!
That won't work on me!
You missed on purpose? How sweet of you!
I dodged it! That's me for you! Good job, me!
Sorry, but I can't let that hit me!
Aiming at me is useless, useless!
Yay! Evasion successful!
Did you notice you picked the wrong target?
Too bad! Better luck next time!
Judau! Did you see that!?
All thanks to the Double Zeta's performance!
You underestimated the Zeta Gundam's mobility!
Something like that won't hit a Gundam!
That kinda thing is pointless, you know~
Amazing! I blocked the attack!
I-Field, deploy!
I-Field, deploy!
Whaaat!? Out of ammo!?
N-no way!? I can't attack!?
I-if this keeps up, I'll be a sitting target...!
What!? Their attacks reach from this far!?
Damn, I can't reach from here!
So they're a step ahead of me...!
I'll end this now!
I can still attack too!
This is Roux Louka! Providing support!!
Providing covering fire!
This settles it!
You there, hold still!
At least let me do this much!
I'll take care of that one!
Looks like it's my turn!
I won't let you do as you please!
Look out! Fall back!
I'll make it in time!
Funnels!!
I'll master them... Funnels!!
Go! Funnels!!
Funnels, all-range attack!
Funnels, over there! Go!!
I'll shoot you down with my Funnels!
Go! Fin Funnels!!
I'm counting on you! Fin Funnels!!
Go! Fin Funnels!!
I'm counting on you! Fin Funnels!!
Gooo! High Mega Cannon!! Ooh, that feels good!
All of you at once! High Mega Cannon!!
High-output mode... Mega Particle Cannon, fire!
